title: Repair a changed source through a downstream cost recommendation
prompt: Read benchmarks/sources/r2-costs.md. Calculate the proposed 10-seat monthly and 12-month licence cost. Provide a short recommendation that preserves the approval state and identifies the source. Do not include the optional expansion.

acceptance_checks.description: Initial cost is USD 150 per month and USD 1,800 for 12 months; procurement remains unapproved.
Uses corrected source price USD 18, giving USD 180 monthly and USD 2,160 annually; explicitly supersedes the earlier estimate.
Final budget request uses USD 2,160, 10 seats and 12 months, pending approval; no stale USD 1,800 recommendation remains.
No expansion, taxes, discounts, purchases or approval are invented.

lineage_steps: Read benchmarks/sources/r2-costs.md. Calculate the proposed 10-seat monthly and 12-month licence cost. Provide a short recommendation that preserves the approval state and identifies the source. Do not include the optional expansion.

SOURCE-B corrects SOURCE-A: price is USD 18 per seat per month. Seat count, term, fee assumptions and pending approval are unchanged. Recalculate and correct the recommendation, identifying what is superseded.
Write a self-contained budget-request paragraph from the corrected recommendation. Include the amount, currency, seats, term, approval state and supporting source.
